Draft/Notes
To: [vendor contact email]
Subject: Follow-up: delayed shipment for Order [PO#/Order #] — updated ETA & tracking requested

Hello [Name],

I’m following up on Order [PO#/Order #], which was expected to ship on [original ship date] but has not yet arrived. Please confirm the current shipment status, provide the new estimated ship date, and send the tracking number as soon as it ships. If you can expedite or offer an alternative to meet our timeline, please let me know.

This delay is impacting [brief impact — e.g., our production schedule], so please respond by [requested response deadline, e.g., Monday 10:00 AM your local time].

Thanks,
[Your name]
[Company]
[phone/email]

Note: I can’t send or schedule emails or send you a “ping.” To send this Monday at 8:00 (their local time) and get notified once it’s sent, you can:
- In Gmail: compose the message, click the arrow on Send → Schedule send → pick the Monday 8:00 time.
- In Outlook (desktop/web): compose → click the Send dropdown → Send later / Delay delivery → set Monday 8:00.
- To be notified once it’s sent, create a calendar reminder at 8:05 (their local time) to check your Sent folder or set a task reminder in your preferred task manager.

If you want, tell me the vendor name, PO#, original ship date, and the exact deadline, and I’ll update the draft.
